steps.label: EMPTY STRING
steps.sub: invisible to a plain IS NULL check

code:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS TotalRows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PhoneNumber IS NULL
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(PhoneNumber)) = ''
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MissingPhone
FROM dbo.Customers;
caption: Catches both NULL and blank-string missingness in one condition.

code:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Email IS NULL
                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Email)) = ''
             THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS DECIMAL(5,2))
        / COUNT(*) * 100 AS EmailCompletenessPct
FROM dbo.Customers;
caption: Run this daily and you have the simplest possible data quality monitor.
